### NAME

`open-webui` - Open WebUI — self-hosted chat UI for local LLMs (branding-clause licence; unfree-class in nixpkgs).

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

Open WebUI is **a home for AI**, a self-hosted AI platform that's **[extensible](https://docs.openwebui.com/features/extensibility/plugin/)**, **[feature-rich](https://docs.openwebui.com/features/)**, user-friendly, and built to run **[entirely offline](https://openwebui.com/sovereign-ai)**.
